primary_benchmark_policy: Only C-problem corpora may drive excellent-paper readiness. Other problem letters remain archive/regression references only.
source_policy: Raw papers and attachments stay in D:\作业\竞赛\大学生数学建模\美赛\备赛\资料; repository stores only manifests and derived signals.

signature: algorithm diversity without one mandatory model

shared_c_problem_priors.name: problem_specific_representation_before_generic_model
shared_c_problem_priors.meaning: Build variables, states, indices, geometry, or domain constructs that answer the actual C-problem semantics before selecting a generic algorithm.

shared_c_problem_priors.name: question_chain_not_independent_model_zoo
shared_c_problem_priors.meaning: Later subproblems should reuse, refine, or challenge accepted earlier research state when the prompt is dependent; do not solve every question as an unrelated model demo.

shared_c_problem_priors.name: data_and_constraint_driven_model_choice
shared_c_problem_priors.meaning: Model choice must be justified by observed data characteristics, domain mechanism, or constraint structure rather than prestige or frequency in excellent papers.

shared_c_problem_priors.name: quantified_answers_in_high_visibility_sections
shared_c_problem_priors.meaning: Abstract/summary and conclusions should report actual task answers and key numbers when evidence exists, not only method names and generic accuracy language.

shared_c_problem_priors.name: validation_matches_claim_type
shared_c_problem_priors.meaning: Forecasts, rankings, optimization, explanation, classification, and uncertainty require family-appropriate validation; a universal RMSE paragraph is not acceptable.

shared_c_problem_priors.name: algorithm_diversity_is_normal
shared_c_problem_priors.meaning: Excellent C papers use very different algorithms for the same problem. Corpus frequency may suggest candidates but must never force one method without local evidence.

shared_c_problem_priors.name: decision_or_deliverable_must_be_evidence_backed
shared_c_problem_priors.meaning: Routes, policies, replenishment plans, targets, letters, and memos must be downstream of accepted quantitative evidence, never invented by the paper renderer.

priors: model evaluation tied to the actual problem

next_gate: Use the five-corpus map to audit ModelingBrain/Validation/Paper priors, then run three real CUMCM C end-to-end gates before human review.
